New MDB & UN Consultant Job Listings – 4 September 2026

Welcome to the latest edition of MDB & UN Consultant Jobs. This week’s update for 4 September 2026 adds 559 career opportunities from 23 leading multilateral development banks and UN organisations.

📅 Update Overview

  • Total positions: 559
  • Sources: 23 multilateral development banks and UN organisations
  • Publication date: 4 September 2026

📂 Job Categories

  • Technical & Sectoral Experts – 205 positions
  • Economics & Policy – 85 positions
  • Technology & Data – 75 positions
  • Operations & Project Management – 74 positions
  • Legal, Compliance & Audit – 43 positions
  • Investment & Finance – 39 positions
  • Administration, HR & Communications – 38 positions

⚠️ Eligibility Note

  • MDBs have strict nationality requirements for applicants. Please check the eligibility list to see which institutions you can apply to.

🎯 How to Apply

  • Review the full list of opportunities.
  • Verify your eligibility for each MDB.
  • Follow the application instructions provided in each job posting.

Stay tuned for future updates and new opportunities.

#MDBJobs #UNConsultants #CareerOpportunities
